name: Blumar S.A.
summary: Blumar S.A. engages in the fishing and aquaculture businesses. The company produces and sells fresh or frozen salmon products in the United States, Brazil and the rest of Latin America, Europe, and Asia. It also provides fishmeal and fish oil products used in the production of animal feed; and frozen mackerel. In addition, the company produces and sells mussels; and other products, such as fillets. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Santiago, Chile.
